entities.summary: Richard Gynge is a Swedish former professional ice hockey player, He represented Brynäs IF, AIK IF and Växjö Lakers of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL), and HC Dynamo Moscow, HC Lev Praha, Admiral Vladivostok, HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk and Traktor Chelyabinsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
